description: The FAST source-connected path for focused tasks. Locate a requested screen/control from owned repository source, reconcile it with Tapp's runtime-observed UI Map, and—when a session is active—execute the shortest replayable route in one call. Use before step-by-step tapping when the user names a destination such as 'Save storefront settings'. Source identifies intent; Tapp never invents navigation from source, and only observed/validated UI Map edges are executed. Without an active session this returns the grounded location/route plan without acting.

mapPath.description: Optional repository-relative UI Map; defaults to .tapp/ui-map.json

platform.description: Optional without an active session; an active session is authoritative

projectDir.description: Repository root; defaults to the MCP workspace

query.description: User's requested screen, control, or focused UI task

name: tapp_focus
title: Locate and reach a requested UI surface
